install_tell: nats-server -m 8222 — monitoring HTTP endpoint has NO auth mechanism at all in OSS NATS, even when client auth (NKey/JWT/user-pass) is fully configured
misconfig_patterns: monitoring port 8222 exposed with no authorization{} block possible on that endpoint
client port 4222 with no authorization{} block — anonymous connect allowed

active_probe.false_positive_check: JSON body must include server_id and jetstream boolean fields — vendor-unique to NATS monitoring

deployment_tells: 4222 sends unauthenticated INFO {json} banner on raw TCP connect before any handshake
8222 /connz leaks connected client IPs and subject subscriptions even when 4222 client auth IS configured — metadata leak survives the auth boundary
pivot_paths: unauth 4222 subscribe to any subject -> read all message traffic
/connz on 8222 -> connected-client IP/subject metadata even behind configured client auth
